**sdd/issue-239-a3/apply-progress**

**What**: Completed Phase 1 of SDD change issue-239-a3 (PR-1 of 3-tranche chain), tasks 1.1-1.14, on branch feat/issue-239-a3-pr1. Original batch (1.1-1.8) shipped the `labelEvents` verb + actor-check's labelEvents dispatch. A fresh-context review then found the fix was INCOMPLETE — actor-check.mjs still had a second gh-CLI-hardcoded fetch (`defaultFetchIssue`), and a class-closure audit found a 4th instance of the same defect in brain-writes-reviewed.mjs. Tasks 1.9-1.14 close both plus add a permanent regression guard.

**Why**: `gatherActorCheckInputs` needs TWO fetches before evaluateActor runs (labelEvents + fetchIssue) — only labelEvents was migrated in the first pass. On GitLab CI (no `gh` binary), `defaultFetchIssue`'s raw `execFileSync('gh',...)` threw ENOENT, so R3 ("GitLab actor-check EVALUATES, not degrades") was never actually met — tests passed only because they injected `deps.fetchIssue`, masking the real default path (lesson #10/#12). This is the 3rd instance of "CI-path fetch ignores runtime provider" (after finding #14 issue-link, and PR-1's own labelEvents pre-fix). An owner-mandated exhaustive audit of all 8 CI governance jobs found a 4th instance: brain-writes-reviewed.mjs's `defaultFetchReviews` had the identical unconditional `execFileSync('gh',...)` bug.

**Where**:
- `brain/scripts/vcs/actor-check.mjs` — `defaultFetchIssue` migrated to dispatch `getVcs({provider}).issueView(...)` via `gitlabApiConfig()` params (mirrors `defaultFetchLabeledEvents`). `execFileSync` import removed (now fully unused).
- `brain/scripts/vcs/providers/github.mjs` — `issueView` extended to return `author` (from `user.login`, same API call); NEW `prReviews` verb (extracted from brain-writes-reviewed.mjs, preserves `--paginate`).
- `brain/scripts/vcs/providers/gitlab.mjs` — `issueView` extended to return `author` (from `author.username`); NEW `prReviews` verb over `gitlabApiFetch`'s `merge_requests/:iid/approvals`, normalizing `approved_by[]` to `{state:'APPROVED', author}` entries (GitLab has no per-reviewer state history like GitHub's Reviews API — approvals is the closest analog).
- `brain/scripts/vcs/brain-writes-reviewed.mjs` — `defaultFetchReviews` migrated to dispatch `getVcs({provider}).prReviews(...)`; `gatherBrainWritesReviewedInputs`/`runBrainWritesReviewedCheck`/`main`/CLI-entrypoint all made async (cascading requirement, same as actor-check.mjs).
- `brain/scripts/vcs/cli.mjs` — VERBS gains `prReviews`.
- `brain/core/methodology/vcs-contract.md` — `issueView` row updated (+author), new `prReviews` row (L6 gate engaged again, 6th slice).
- NEW `brain/scripts/vcs/no-gh-glab-spawn-regression.test.mjs` — class-closure regression guard: (1) behavioral test running all 7 JS-invokable governance entrypoints under provider:gitlab with mocked getVcs, asserting zero gh/glab spawns via setSpawn; (2) structural source-scan companion asserting no raw `execFileSync('gh'|'glab', ...)` literal exists in run-check.mjs/phase-order-check.mjs/actor-check.mjs/brain-writes-reviewed.mjs — added because the behavioral mock-based test has a BLIND SPOT (a raw execFileSync bypasses any injected getVcs mock entirely and setSpawn does NOT intercept raw execFileSync — verified empirically). Test-only file, excluded from the 400-line budget.
- Tests updated: actor-check.test.mjs (+2 new RED tests: real-default-path + source-scan), brain-writes-reviewed.test.mjs (async conversion of ~15 test bodies + 2 new RED tests), providers.test.mjs (+6 issueView/prReviews tests).
- `openspec/changes/issue-239-a3/tasks.md` — added tasks 1.9-1.14 + a PLAN-DEVIATION note explaining the m3-inherited under-scoping (spec.md's REQ-A3-3/R3 was always correct; only tasks.md scoped the implementation short).

**Learned**: (1) A source-scan-only proof was insufficient for "no CLI spawn" claims — a mock-injection test (deps.getVcs) can pass even when the REAL default code path still hardcodes a CLI, because tests that inject bypasses never exercise the default. The fix pattern: write a RED test that deliberately does NOT inject the leaf-level dep (fetchIssue/fetchReviews), only injects one layer lower (getVcs), forcing the real wrapper to run end-to-end. (2) A regex-based structural guard can false-positive on its OWN explanatory doc comments if those comments quote the literal buggy pattern (`execFileSync('gh', ...)`) — had to reword two JSDoc blocks to avoid self-triggering the guard. (3) `setSpawn` from lib/exec.mjs does NOT intercept raw `execFileSync` calls (only `run()`/`runJson()`-mediated ones) — confirmed empirically; this is why the generalized regression guard needs BOTH a behavioral test AND a structural source-scan to actually close the class, not just the instance.

Final state: 1169/1169 tests pass (was 1148 pre-PR-1 baseline). `npm run brain:repo:check` and `npm run brain:nav` both green. Diff budget: 395/400 non-test counted lines (vcs-contract.md +6, actor-check.mjs +137, brain-writes-reviewed.mjs +80, cli.mjs +2, github.mjs +79, gitlab.mjs +91 = 395). All 14 Phase-1 tasks marked [x]. Phase 2 (GitLab prView/mrCreate un-stub) and Phase 3 (contract suite + fixtures) NOT started.
